description: Depth-1 production-chain fixture on the pinned seed-20260823 map: five §2.6 workshops (sawpit, kiln, smithy, forge, kitchen) are stamped finished and six villagers staff them via produce commands — one crafter each, the sixth overflowing the sawpit's single slot. Inputs debit from the seven-slug resource ledger at cycle START, outputs credit the commodity ledger on the pinned completion tick (commandTargetTick + recipe.ticks), and every completed meals batch appends a digest-visible MealConsumed event. With ample inputs and in-range staff the lines never stall, so the commodity ledger closes against exact cycle counts. Milestone digests every 30th tick plus final; doubles as the determinism canary.
